candidate_workaround: Persist sanitized failing test identifiers in the bounded validation receipt before returning nonzero.
failure_signature: A bounded unittest selection reports only aggregate failure counts, forcing a second diagnostic run to identify the failed assertions.
recurrence_guard: Include sanitized test identifiers, not private traces or paths, in every failed bounded-test receipt.
rollback: Retain the opaque failure receipt and run one bounded diagnostic selection; do not infer the failing assertions.
scope_boundary: Failure identifiers only; private traces and local paths remain excluded.
title: Sanitized failing-test identifiers in validation receipts
trigger_preconditions: A bounded unittest selection can fail inside a validation runner.
